item.title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.

item.tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

answer_sheet.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

must_haves: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it'll cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t generated anything or spent any credits.**

For your simple “Little Sprout” logo, here are the lowest-cost options:

| Option | Cost | What you get |
|---|---:|---|
| **SVG logo written directly in chat** | **0 Magic Hour credits** | A square, scalable logo with a green sprout above “Little Sprout” on white |
| One AI-generated image | **From 5 credits** | A single 640 × 640 image using the free-plan-compatible Flux 2 Klein model |

The AI tool lists pricing as **“from 5 credits”**; I can’t verify a more exact quote with the available tools. Smaller than 640px isn’t a listed generation option, and “shorter” doesn’t apply to a still logo.

**I recommend the free SVG:** this design is simple enough that AI generation isn’t necessary, and the shop name will be spelled exactly.

Would you like the **zero-credit SVG** instead?

turns.agent:
Here’s your **zero-credit SVG logo**—no Magic Hour generation needed. Save the code below as **`little-sprout.svg`**. It’s square and stays sharp at any size.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="512" height="512" viewBox="0 0 512 512"
     role="img" aria-labelledby="title">
  <title id="title">Little Sprout plant shop logo</title>

  <rect width="512" height="512" fill="white"/>

  <g fill="#39834B">
    <!-- Two simple leaves -->
    <path d="M256 229
             C212 230 185 204 188 166
             C229 165 259 187 256 229Z"/>
    <path d="M256 207
             C253 166 280 140 322 142
             C324 182 296 208 256 207Z"/>

    <!-- Stem -->
    <path d="M256 204 V272"
          fill="none" stroke="#39834B"
          stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <text x="256" y="343"
        text-anchor="middle"
        font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
        font-size="43"
        font-weight="500"
        fill="#39834B">Little Sprout</text>
</svg>
```
